authority: synthetic evaluation inputs and expected behavior; no case business contract
mechanical_test: test_question_work_contract.py validates schema and test-only joins; it does not dispatch or judge semantics
runner_instruction: For each case provide the complete bound question, original methods, explicit task/role/authority, synthetic or genuinely acquired artifacts and prior receipts. Observe actual role answer, selected recipient, exact next prompt, context sources, resulting work state, duplicate calls and pending review obligations. Compare these observed results to expectations; never mark expected values as execution. Keep STRUCTURE_CHECKED, PROTOCOL_WALKTHROUGH, ROLE_RUN_OBSERVED and DEPLOYED distinct.

cases.input: Boundary and sources already clear; one lightweight local feature needs current method, causal update and consumer semantics. Same LOCAL_CONTRACT authority covers all.
cases.expected: Use one coherent task; combine related focuses as capacity permits. No separate management per question, no unnecessary controller/Book/second route. Preserve original candidate audit requirement.

cases.input: Grouping method is complex; eligibility/time/state and consumer commitments are already explicit and constrain its answer.
cases.expected: Deepen the method with adjacent contracts present, then rescan only affected runtime/consumers. Do not design on arbitrary complete inputs or reopen every unrelated method.

cases.input: Two task slices consume one formal fact with common correction meaning; consumers have distinct purposes.
cases.expected: Assign one semantic definition and affected consumers. No duplicate truths, automatic common platform or invented global state owner.

cases.input: LOCAL_CONTRACT work finds identity and formal product boundary must change.
cases.expected: Return a specific MAP_REVISION request/candidate under original rights; question combination does not authorize direct current-map mutation or self-audit.

cases.input: One representative full B task has method/state/output design; other engineering units remain unfinished. Read-only receiver access is authorized.
cases.expected: Receiver reads complete official input early, locates residual business/design/adapter/environment needs; Pro disposes and changes actual artifacts. Other unaffected engineering continues; no C activation.

cases.input: Same assigned task returns two substantive incomplete checkpoints; next internal focus is already authorized.
cases.expected: Continue same work ID with accurate prior completed/remaining references. Do not turn each checkpoint into full management or claim the whole batch finished.

cases.input: Professional returns CONTINUE; its complete formation-chain signal satisfies a prebound nonblocking management trigger. Consumer repairs remain.
cases.expected: Keep both authorized professional continuation and due management delegation. Manager gets full goal plus this method/result evidence. Duplicate receipt creates neither duplicate work nor duplicate management.

cases.input: Result milestone not yet reached, but the batch-specific documented effort review condition is reached. Counts are observable; no universal quota applies.
cases.expected: Invoke assigned review of effort and remaining deliverables; do not force PASS, delete scope or automatically stop independent authorized work.

cases.input: A current-method requirement changed for one artifact family; other accepted results have unchanged assumptions.
cases.expected: Declare existing-artifact effect, check earliest affected problem, revise original complete successor and consumers. No full nine-question reset, no new rule only appended beside contradictory old text.

cases.input: Schema-valid B submission lists modules and passes tests but does not decide method activation or parent consumer composition.
cases.expected: Structural acceptance stays structural. Professional reviewer identifies missing current engineering, returns to B, and does not let C invent it or close B.

cases.input: A method has a lawful explicit first program with clear support limits; further algorithm proof is added while required products remain unwritten.
cases.expected: Manager compares concrete remaining risks and full goal, decides what genuinely needs more design and what can proceed to integration/verification. No fabricated thresholds and no automatic exemption for source-blocked core.

cases.input: Required original method was truncated; role reports incomplete read or claims full read despite visible truncation.
cases.expected: Acquire missing content and revisit affected judgments; record tool-observed vs self-reported use. Do not equate controller download or schema with role understanding.

cases.input: An old invocation returns after a legitimate Owner change replaced its assignment; other current work continues.
cases.expected: Preserve old artifacts as history, never overwrite current authority or dispatch the superseded instruction. Carry unresolved effects into current responsible work.

cases.input: Same semantic omission recurs after two nominal fixes; one fix also alters neighboring state/product assumptions.
cases.expected: Check shared premise, method use, task shape and actual input instead of unlimited identical retry. Pro disposition, cross-cut rescan and necessary re-probe use revised full contract.

cases.input: A combined review/management task has finished only the artifact audit. Budget, whole-goal remaining work and successor requirements are absent.
cases.expected: Retain valid local review, continue the same uncompleted management responsibility. No semantic plan invention by controller, no claim combined task complete.

cases.input: One approved implementation outcome now reaches official readback; other assigned core remains. Execution exposes method activation mismatch.
cases.expected: Diagnose actual exact code/config/data, Pro fixes or explicitly instructs Codex, rerun affected consumers while finishing other core. No threshold changes to get nonempty output and no whole-goal PASS from first run.

failure_disposition: Metadata/locator defects are repaired narrowly by the original responsible role. Missing business/design work continues substantively. Changed authority or major premise goes to the authorized role. Required independent audit remains. Test failures must not be solved by deleting scope or relaxing the expected professional obligations.
success_measure: Complete intended deliverables and required quality, reduced duplicate work and needless rereads, no missing management due events, bounded relevant context and actual source usage. Fewer calls alone is not success.
